title: GeminiCLI.com Feedback: Missing location list for authentication

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue clearly describes a missing documentation link in the Vertex AI authentication guide (docs/get-started/authentication.mdx) regarding available Google Cloud locations/regions for GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION. The report provides the exact page section, problem, expected behavior, and potential reference links.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: This is a documentation update in docs/get-started/authentication.mdx to add a link pointing to the official Google Cloud Vertex AI locations/regions documentation for GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION.

summary.problem: The documentation page at docs/get-started/authentication.mdx under the 'Use Vertex AI' section specifies setting the GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION environment variable but does not link to the list of supported Vertex AI regions/locations.
summary.root_cause: The documentation lacks a hyperlink or reference to official Vertex AI available locations documentation when instructing users how to set GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION.
summary.context: Users setting up Vertex AI authentication need to know valid location values (such as us-central1 or europe-west1) for the GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION environment variable.

steps: Open docs/get-started/authentication.mdx and locate the 'Use Vertex AI' section.
Add a link to the official Vertex AI locations documentation (https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/learn/locations) where GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION is introduced.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: The Vertex AI section in docs/get-started/authentication.mdx contains a clear link to the official list of supported Vertex AI locations.
verification_steps: Inspect docs/get-started/authentication.mdx to confirm the Vertex AI section links to the official Vertex AI locations documentation for GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION.
